source_caption_text:
#YellaBeezy’s Girlfriend Shares A Heartfelt Message On Latest Instagram Post After The Rapper Was Sentenced To Life 💔🥺:

“My best friend... you were so busy picking apart my friends that you didn’t even pay attention to your own.. A taxpaying, law-abiding citizen”

Yella Beezy, whose real name is Markies Deandre Conway, is a rapper from Dallas, Texas, who rose to fame with his breakout hit “That’s On Me.” Born and raised in the Oak Cliff neighborhood of Dallas, Beezy became one of the biggest names in the Texas rap scene, gaining national recognition for his Southern sound, catchy hooks, and music that reflected his upbringing & experiences in the streets.

Yella Beezy began pursuing music at a young age, releasing several mixtapes before achieving mainstream success. His 2017 project Lite Work, Vol. 2 featured “That’s On Me,” which eventually became a massive hit and helped launch his career to another level. The song’s success led to collaborations with major artists such as Lil Baby, Quavo, Gucci Mane, 2 Chainz, and Chris Brown. He continued building his name with popular tracks like “Bacc At It Again,” “Restroom Occupied,” and “Goin Through Some Thangs.”

Throughout his career, Beezy experienced several personal hardships. He lost his father at a young age and survived a sh**ting in 2018, an incident that occurred just as his music career was taking off. Despite those challenges, he continued releasing music, performing across the country, and establishing himself as one of Dallas’ most recognizable hip-hop artists.

However, Yella Beezy’s career took a major turn in March 2025 when he was arrested and charged with capital m**der in connection with the 2020 death of fellow Dallas rapper Mo3. Prosecutors accused Beezy of paying $40,000 to have Mo3 k*lled following a long-running feud between the two artists. Beezy pleaded not guilty, and his legal team maintained his innocence throughout the trial.

On November 11, 2026, exactly six years after Mo3’s death, a Dallas County jury found Yella Beezy GUILTY of capital m**der.
